name: Violet Mister

stealth.details: (trained) to notice the trap's trigger-thread attached to the door

disable: DC 18 Thievery check to safely cut the thread

items.name: Poisoned Welcome
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the door

---

Effect Every creature within 10 feet of the door is exposed to violet venom poison.

items.name: Violet Venom

text: Opening the door pulls a thread, which causes a plant mister to spray a cloud of poison into the triggering creature's face.
